command:
set +e
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH
mkdir -p /tmp/out && cd /tmp/out
s=$(date +%s)
iqtree3 -s /tmp/auto.fa -m LG+G4 -T 4 -seed 12345 --prefix probe -quiet
rc=$?; e=$(date +%s)
echo "rc=$rc wall_s=$((e-s)) memory_peak_kib=$(( $(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak) / 1024 )) vcpus=$(grep -c ^processor /proc/cpuinfo)" | tee probe.txt
grep -E 'Log-likelihood of the tree|Total CPU time|Total wall-clock' probe.iqtree | tee -a probe.txt
grep -E 'Iteration|BEST SCORE' probe.log | tail -n 3 | tee -a probe.txt
